name: contextos
description: The context exoskeleton for AI development: optimize the entire development lifecycle to reduce token usage and context occupancy.

interface.shortDescription: Intent-level context OS: explore, change, verify, ship.
interface.longDescription: State what you want and the OS does the rest: it slices code with a real AST engine, keeps terminal output out of context, derives architecture modules from source, attaches verification receipts automatically and returns everything inside a context budget.
capabilities: OS Markdown documents and chapter retrieval
Resumable sessions and manual passthrough to every legacy capability
Read-only README in the knowledge reader
defaultPrompt: Use ContextOS for repository reads, edits, and verification. Batch changes with verify.
